# Frozen MARS-S2L source

`marss2l-f7d264c2c845dfba.zip` contains the upstream library, its Linux candidate dependency lock, project metadata, citation, and license. It contains no imagery, weights, or virtual environment. Its JSON receipt records the source revision, archive digest, and every member's size and SHA-256.

The archive preserves the bytes used by the frozen Model8 baseline. Some source files contain CRLF line endings. Keep those bytes on Linux. The preparation script checks the frozen source hashes before creating paths for training.

Upstream: https://github.com/UNEP-IMEO-MARS/marss2l at `f7d264c2c845dfba1cb27f76ef6026275f8d8758`.

License: LGPL-3.0-or-later. The upstream `LICENCE` and `CITATION.cff` are retained in the archive. No upstream library code was changed for this snapshot. Runtime installation and CUDA operation still require checks on the destination server.
